title: Why do birds lay eggs?
examples: Do baby birds eat the yolk?
How long are eggs in the nest?

explain.say: Birds lay eggs. The eggs keep the baby birds safe while they grow.

draw.text: Eggs keep babies safe until hatch.

explain.say: The hard shell protects the little bird inside.
Inside the egg, the yolk is food for the growing chick.

draw.text: Food inside egg helps baby grow.

explain.say: When the chick is ready, it pecks a crack in the shell. Then it hatches out.

draw.text: Crack helps baby bird hatch out.

explain.say: Many birds build a nest. The parent sits on the eggs to keep them warm.

draw.text: Nest keeps eggs warm and safe.

explain.say: Birds choose safe places for their eggs, like nests in trees or hedges.

draw.text: Birds choose safe spots for eggs.

faq.q: Why do birds lay eggs instead of giving birth?
faq.a: That is how birds have babies. The shell keeps the baby safe while it grows.

faq.q: How long does it take for a baby bird to hatch?
faq.a: It depends on the bird. Many small birds hatch after about two weeks.
asks: When do baby birds come out?

faq.q: What keeps the baby bird safe inside the egg?
faq.a: The hard shell around the egg keeps the baby safe from getting hurt by things outside the nest. It is a protective covering.
asks: What protects the baby in the egg?

faq.q: Does the egg give the baby all its food?
faq.a: Yes. The yolk gives the chick its food until it hatches.
asks: Where does the baby get food from?
Can the egg feed the baby?

faq.q: Can birds lay eggs in any place?
faq.a: No, birds usually choose a safe, hidden spot like a nest to lay their eggs. They look for protection first.
asks: Where do birds like to lay eggs?

facts: Bird eggs have a hard outer shell for protection.
The yolk inside the egg provides food for the growing chick.
Birds typically build a nest to keep eggs warm and safe.
Hatching is the process when the baby bird breaks out of the shell.

quiz.say: What does the hard shell of an egg do?
quiz.why: The hard shell protects the chick while it grows.

wrong.0: The yolk inside gives the chick its food.
wrong.2: The chick pecks its own way out when it is ready.

quiz.say: Which part of the egg is food for the chick?
quiz.why: The yolk is the chick's food while it grows.

wrong.1: The shell is the hard outside, for protection.
wrong.2: The air pocket gives the chick its first breath, just before hatching.

quiz.say: Where do many birds lay their eggs to keep them safe?
quiz.show: 🐦 🥚 Where are the eggs kept safe?
quiz.why: A nest keeps the eggs warm and safe.

wrong.0: A puddle would make the eggs cold and wet.
wrong.1: Eggs on a busy path could get stepped on.
